title: A calculation group that is not filtered applies nothing, even when it has one item

source.quote: noSelectionExpression. This selection expression is applied when the calculation group is not filtered.
source.supports: with no selection expression defined, the page's table gives "Calculation group is not filtered" for no selection

source.quote: Calculation groups are only applied if a single calculation item from the calculation group is in filter context.
source.supports: an item is applied only when selected

derivation: Neither Adder nor Multiplier is filtered, so neither item applies: [Just2] = 2 (not 7, 20 or 70).
